B changes the required Upload signature, adds explicitly prohibited association APIs, and broadly modifies retry behavior with unsafe error handling.","reasons":["A preserves the exact required Upload signature with opts ...FilesOption, uses multipartbody.NewFile(\"file\", fileName, content), validates both arguments, and produces a replayable *bytes.Reader.","B instead exposes opts ...AddFileOption, so existing FilesOption values cannot be passed to the required convenience API.","B adds deal/person/organization/product/activity/project/lead association fields despite the contract explicitly prohibiting association fields.","B refactors global RawClient retry behavior outside scope. makeBodyReplayable silently ignores io.ReadAll errors after potentially consuming part of the original body, allowing a corrupted or truncated request to proceed instead of propagating the source-reader failure."],"risks_a":["Upload duplicates Add's option handling, request execution, decoding, and missing-data error instead of routing through Add as explicitly required.","The visible tests omit empty-filename, nil-content, and source-reader-error coverage.","The retry test uses strings.NewReader rather than demonstrating an os.File or deliberately one-shot streamed source."],"risks_b":["Violates the mandated public API signature and adds a parallel option hierarchy.","Adds explicitly forbidden association functionality and unnecessary multipart helper machinery.","Does not route Upload through Add, duplicating request and response logic there as well like A does; source-reader failures may be mishandled globally by makeBodyReplayable."]}
